what: Die contract switches, default 0: ot_hgi_vm_die TUNIT (ot_hgi_vm_tunit, el1011-hbm-hcvm ee633319d) and tb_hgi_e2e VM_TUNIT (VM models take tunit's latency deltas: responses +7, wide-write done +4); tools/hbm_hub_quarter_gen.py --sfut N for the sfu quarter lanes (el1011-hbm-sfu SFUT contract)

tunit_lockstep.loop_failure_cause: hgi_vm_tb-76157b4a6-tc-cl ran a commit before the lockstep fix ee633319d (status 60000 vs 20000 = out-of-range addresses counted by the old reference)

die_blocker: ot_hgi_vm_tunit elaborates only NC<=8 / WP32 / WDIRECT1 / RP0 / W2 0 / AP0; the r25gqn die VM is NC 9 / RP 96 / W2 96 / LQ 32 / AP 1, so ot_hgi_vm_die TUNIT=1 does not elaborate until tunit supports that configuration (TUNIT=0 lints clean, Verilator 5.050)

e2e.harness: tb_hgi_e2e --real dma, DMA_VR2 1 DMA_KVW 1, FLAT 40 KLAT 40 VLAT 6, hgi-1010e vectors, ot-epyc3

vm_tunit_0.note: 24 per-record mismatches (pre-existing wr_quiet, same at TUNIT 0)

sfut: --sfut asserts the sfu lane module (ot_su12_sfu) declares SFUT; on main it does not yet (el1011-hbm-sfu lane top pending). No HBM die view on main instantiates ot_hdc_v41x_vec_c12; the HGI die SU/SFU control (su_ctlw = ot_hgi_su_unit) runs ot_hdc_v41x_vec, which has no SFUT
